newsitem.title: USA: Washington Post names Schroeder treasurer.
newsitem.headline: Washington Post names Schroeder treasurer.

text.p: The Washington Post Co said Thursday Christopher Schroeder has been elected treasurer. The company said Schroeder will continue as director of corporate strategy, a position he has held since joining the company in August 1995.

Schroeder, 32, was previously a partner with a Thayer Capital Partners, Washington, D.C., acquisitions group, and worked in corporate finance and mergers and acquisitions at Salomon Brothers in New York, the company said, adding that Schroeder also served in the State Department during the Bush Administration.
